name: @odu/ci
//cordis: THE ROW this package belongs to, read by the fence.
//: THE RUNS' ROW — see README.md. Its server side (the ports bound to the engine, and the plugin the daemon mounts), and its face (the board, the DAG, the console). It is a package of its own for the reason `@odu/cache` is: a row owns everything about itself, and the daemon-side composition that binds the engine's launcher must not sit inside the CLI face where only import topology keeps it out of a public client.
//exports: TWO DOORS. `./row` is what the daemon mounts — the plugin and its Cordis facts — plus the port bindings behind it; `./face` is the Solid view and the primitives the shell shares with it. The engine imports are behind `./row`, which is why the CLI face's manifest no longer names the launch machinery.
//dependencies: `@odu/service` and `@odu/service-client` are the contract and its implementation; `@odu/execution`, `@odu/run-history` and `@odu/run-client` are the engine the ports bind; `@odu/cordis` is the vocabulary the daemon and its rows share; `solid-js` is `./face`'s cost. `@kolu/surface` and `@olai/effect-cordis` are HYDRATED from npins pins and so are absent by design.
